back_story: Every empire needs a cornerstone. Tommy's was a run-down construction site at the edge of town — bought cheap, rebuilt into a mansion that doubled as his headquarters. The crane above the half-finished walls is the honest symbol of Vice City's dream: concrete, cash, and the nerve to build your own skyline.
